scope: scripts/qualify_typed_graphical.py, engineering-only, typed-insert-lad and typed-insert-fbd on fresh owned TIA V21 scratch projects: a typed Boolean network inserted after the first network of an existing native caller (Tgp_Boolean_LAD/FBD). The builder predicted V21's renumbering (inserted unit IDs 8..C; block title IDs 8->D, 9->E). Each case passed import/compile, complete prepared XML equal to the native readback, the independent insertion contract (only following IDs shifted by exactly the inserted count; removing the unit and undoing the shift recovers the original caller exactly), untouched peers, save and fresh reopen, and checkpoint restore with recovered reopen.
limitations: Under the 25 October 2026 scope decision (docs/plans/insertion-id-renumbering-decision-20261025.md, PR #49): renumbered following document-local IDs count as preserved; nothing else may change.
